Title: KUKA FM Middleware
Description: Middleware between an upstream system and KUKA AMR Fleet Manager: dispatch/cancel missions, sync mission and robot states, web UI.

Title: Mission Management
Description: Dispatching, cancelling and monitoring missions created by the middleware (UC1–UC5).
Acceptance Criteria:
• Missions can be dispatched, cancelled and monitored through the middleware without using the KUKA FM UI
• Only missions dispatched by the middleware are tracked, each with current status and full status history
• All user operations and KUKA calls are logged in Seq

Title: UC1 Dispatch mission
Description: As an operator I want to dispatch a new RACK_MOVE mission to a selected robot.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Dialog requires a robot from the DB, start node, target node, container code and priority 1–99
• Invalid input is rejected with 400 and no KUKA call is made
• On KUKA success the mission is stored with status 10 (Created) and appears in the list
• On KUKA error an error is shown (502), nothing is stored and the error is logged

Title: Endpoint POST /api/missions + input validation
Description: Create POST /api/missions. Validate start node, target node, container code, priority (1–99) and that the robot exists. Return 201 or a validation error.

Title: DB: insert mission
Description: Persist the new mission with status 10 (Created), generated mission_code/request_id and robot FK. Write only after KUKA FM confirms success.

Title: KUKA FM: submitMission call (RACK_MOVE)
Description: Call submitMission at https://kukafm.its.fei with Authorization token. Build RACK_MOVE body (missionData start/target node, robotIds); other params from appsettings. Handle success=false.

Title: Dispatch dialog + robot select
Description: Dialog opened by '+ Dispatch mission' with robot select (robots from DB), start/target node, container code and priority. Show success or error message.

Title: Unit tests for dispatch mission
Description: Unit tests for input validation, KUKA submitMission request mapping and service logic (KUKA client and DB mocked).

Title: UC2 Cancel mission
Description: As an operator I want to force-cancel a running mission.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Cancel is offered only for active missions (10, 20, 25, 28, 50) and needs confirmation
• missionCancel is sent with FORCE
• Unknown mission returns 404, non-active mission returns 409
• Final status Cancelled (31) appears after the next sync

Title: Endpoint POST /api/missions/{code}/cancel
Description: Create POST /api/missions/{code}/cancel. Return 200 on success, 404 if not found, 409 if mission is not active.

Title: DB: load mission + active status check
Description: Load mission by mission_code and check that its status is active (10, 20, 25, 28, 50).

Title: KUKA FM: missionCancel call (FORCE)
Description: Call missionCancel with missionCode and cancelMode FORCE. Final status (31 Cancelled) is stored later by mission sync.

Title: Cancel button + confirm dialog
Description: Cancel button shown only on active missions; confirmation dialog mentioning FORCE cancel; show result message.

Title: Unit tests for cancel mission
Description: Unit tests for active / not-active / not-found cases and KUKA FM error handling (KUKA client and DB mocked).

Title: UC3 View mission status
Description: As an operator I want to see the current status of active and finished missions.
Acceptance Criteria:
• List shows code, status, robot, nodes, container, priority and times
• All / Active / Finished filter works
• Data refreshes every 1 s while Auto-refresh is on

Title: Endpoint GET /api/missions (active/finished filter)
Description: Create GET /api/missions with optional filter state=active|finished; return missions with status code and name, robot and timestamps.

Title: DB: missions query
Description: EF Core query over mission table with status filter, robot join and ordering by created_at desc.

Title: Missions table + filter + 1 s polling
Description: Missions table (code, status badge, robot, nodes, container, priority, times) with All/Active/Finished filter and auto-refresh every 1 s.

Title: Unit tests for view mission status
Description: Unit tests for the active/finished filter logic and the missions service.

Title: UC4 View mission status history
Description: As an operator I want to see all previous statuses of a mission.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Show history shows all previous states, newest first, with valid-from and valid-to times
• Unknown mission returns 404

Title: Endpoint GET /api/missions/{code}/history
Description: Create GET /api/missions/{code}/history returning previous states (status, robot, valid_from, valid_to).

Title: DB: mission history query
Description: Query mission_status_history by mission_id ordered by valid_to desc.

Title: Show history rows in missions table
Description: 'Show history' checkbox adds grey previous-state rows under each mission.

Title: Unit tests for view mission status history
Description: Unit tests for the mission history service (existing/unknown mission).

Title: UC5 Synchronize mission status
Description: As the system I want to periodically sync statuses of tracked missions from KUKA FM.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Starts only after the first robot sync
• One jobQuery per tick plus per-jobCode fallback for missing missions
• Every change stores the previous state in history; a final status sets completed_at and the mission is no longer polled
• KUKA errors are logged, nothing is written and the next tick retries

Title: Scheduler job for mission sync (interval from appsettings)
Description: Hosted background service running on interval from appsettings; starts only after first robot sync finished; logs to Seq.

Title: DB: update mission + write status history
Description: For each changed mission copy previous state into mission_status_history, update status/robot/updated_at; set completed_at for final statuses.

Title: KUKA FM: jobQuery call (once per tick)
Description: Call jobQuery once per tick (limit and filters from appsettings) and match results to active missions by jobCode.

Title: Unit tests for mission sync
Description: Unit tests for sync logic: status change, no change, final status, unknown jobCode and KUKA FM error.

Title: Robot Management
Description: Monitoring robots and their states synchronized from KUKA FM (UC6–UC8).
Acceptance Criteria:
• All robots from KUKA FM are synced periodically with current state and full history
• UI shows robots with mapped state Available / Busy / Offline

Title: UC6 View robot status
Description: As an operator I want to see all robots and their current state.
Acceptance Criteria:
• List shows code, type, state badge, KUKA status, battery, map, node, mission and updated time
• State mapping: Idle → Available; Departure, Executing, Charging, Updating → Busy; Offline, Abnormal → Offline
• Data refreshes every 1 s while Auto-refresh is on

Title: Endpoint GET /api/robots + status mapping (Available/Busy/Offline)
Description: Create GET /api/robots returning robots with KUKA status and mapped state (Idle→Available; Departure/Executing/Charging/Updating→Busy; Offline/Abnormal→Offline).

Title: DB: robots query
Description: EF Core query over robot table ordered by robot_code.

Title: Robots table + 1 s polling
Description: Robots table (code, type, state badge, KUKA status, battery bar, map, node, mission, updated) with auto-refresh every 1 s.

Title: Unit tests for view robot status
Description: Unit tests for status mapping (Available/Busy/Offline) and the robots service.

Title: UC7 View robot status history
Description: As an operator I want to see all previous states of a robot.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Show history shows previous states, newest first, with valid-from and valid-to times
• Unknown robot returns 404

Title: Endpoint GET /api/robots/{id}/history
Description: Create GET /api/robots/{id}/history returning previous states with valid_from/valid_to.

Title: DB: robot history query
Description: Query robot_status_history by robot_id ordered by valid_to desc.

Title: Show history rows in robots table
Description: 'Show history' checkbox adds grey previous-state rows under each robot.

Title: Unit tests for view robot status history
Description: Unit tests for the robot history service (existing/unknown robot).

Title: UC8 Synchronize robot status
Description: As the system I want to periodically sync all robots from KUKA FM.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Runs first on startup, then on the configured interval
• New robots are inserted
• Any change stores the previous state in history, then updates the robot
• KUKA errors are logged, nothing is written and the next tick retries
• The token is never logged

Title: Scheduler job for robot sync (runs before mission sync on startup)
Description: Hosted background service on interval from appsettings; runs first on startup and signals mission sync to start.

Title: DB: insert/update robot + write status history
Description: Insert new robots; for every changed robot copy previous state into robot_status_history and update current values.

Title: KUKA FM: robotQuery call
Description: Call robotQuery without filters to get all robots; map response fields to robot entity.

Title: Unit tests for robot sync
Description: Unit tests for sync logic: new robot, changed robot, unchanged robot and KUKA FM error.

Title: Deployment
Description: Containerization, CI and CD of the whole application on the local Azure DevOps Windows agent with Docker Desktop.
Acceptance Criteria: • Application runs fully in Docker and is built, checked and deployed by Azure DevOps pipelines without manual file edits

Title: Containerize application
Description: As a team we want the application to run fully in Docker containers.
Acceptance Criteria:
• docker compose up --build starts web (8080), api (internal only), postgres (5432) and seq (5341)
• UI and /api work through nginx
• Dev and prod use separate volumes

Title: Backend Dockerfile (multi-stage .NET build)
Description: Multi-stage Dockerfile: build and publish with .NET SDK image, run on ASP.NET runtime image.

Title: Frontend Dockerfile (Angular build + nginx image)
Description: Multi-stage Dockerfile: build Angular app with Node image, serve static files from nginx image.

Title: nginx config: serve SPA + proxy /api to backend
Description: nginx.conf serving SPA with fallback to index.html and reverse proxy /api to the backend container.

Title: docker-compose: api, web, postgres, seq with volumes
Description: Compose file with web (8080), api (internal only), postgres (5432) and seq (5341) with persistent volumes; images always built.

Title: Environment configs
Description: appsettings.Development.json with root/password DB credentials; Production values injected by the pipeline.

Title: CI pipeline
Description: As a team we want every change built, checked and tested automatically.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Manual run builds backend and frontend
• Run fails on vulnerable NuGet packages, high/critical npm audit findings or failing unit tests
• Test results are published

Title: ci.yml: build backend + frontend
Description: Azure Pipelines YAML building backend and frontend; agent pool and name taken from pipeline variables.

Title: NuGet vulnerability check
Description: Fail the build when vulnerable NuGet packages are found.

Title: npm audit check
Description: Run npm audit on the frontend and fail on high/critical vulnerabilities.

Title: Run backend tests + publish results
Description: Run dotnet test for backend unit tests and publish test results to the pipeline.

Title: CD pipeline (local Docker)
Description: As a team we want successful builds deployed automatically to local Docker.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Manual run only
• Placeholders are replaced from secret variables before any docker command; secrets never appear in logs or the repo
• Smoke check passes for :8080 and /api/health
• Migrations are applied on API startup

Title: cd.yml
Description: Azure Pipelines YAML used for deployment. Manual run only (trigger: none).

Title: Generate appsettings.Production.json from pipeline variables
Description: Create appsettings.Production.json from secret pipeline variables (KUKA FM token, DB credentials).

Title: docker compose build + up -d on agent Docker Desktop
Description: Run docker compose build and up -d on the agent host's Docker Desktop (Linux containers). Include docker builder prune -af to cleanup used resources.

Title: Apply DB migrations on API startup
Description: API applies EF Core migrations on startup (Database.Migrate()) so every deployment updates the PostgreSQL schema; no migration step in the pipeline.

Title: Smoke check after deployment (frontend + /api)
Description: After deploy verify that the frontend (8080) and /api through nginx respond; fail the pipeline otherwise.
